Category: Very Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Type: Iconic Drug

Iconic Drug. PRIMARY EFFECT: lasts 1 month, and a second dose inside that month does nothing and adds no time. While it runs, the user gets +4 to Endurance and Athletics checks, +2 to Resist Torture/Drugs checks (not the check against this drug's own Secondary Effect), halves every MOVE penalty they take from any source rounding up, and adds 2m/yds to the Run Action. SECONDARY EFFECT (DV21): the user is now addicted to Lactic Acid Recyclers if they weren't. While addicted they take -4 to Endurance and Athletics checks, and their DEX and MOVE drop by 2 to a minimum of 2, both unless the Primary Effect is running. They always feel a breath short of winded; roleplay accordingly.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • The +2 Resist Torture/Drugs does not apply to the check against this drug's own Secondary Effect; the sheet can't tell those apart, so switch it off for that roll.
  • While addicted, switch on the "Military-Grade Lactic Acid Recyclers Addiction" effect; switch it off again while the Primary Effect is running, which cancels it.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; the month-long duration, caps, minimums and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Gear).
